newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZCCM buys 5,000T coal from Wankie.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM buys 5,000T coal from Wankie.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) has ordered 5,000 tonnes of coal from neighbouring Zimbabwe's Wankie Colliery to ensure uninterrupted operations at the Nkana smelter.
An official for Wankie Colliery told state news agency ZIANA that further orders depended on how quickly flood damage at Zambia's Maamba Collieries Ltd could be repaired.
"It looks like a one-off order probably caused by the flooding. Whether more orders will come will depend on how long they (take to) solve the problem at Maamba," he said.
Heavy rain disrupted production at Maamba Collieries, Zambia's largest coal mine, after its open pit was flooded and equipment at its central works was damaged.
